features.feature: Audit all CLI paths that commit to or mutate the main branch or main worktree and flag any not under the main-write-lock
Identify unlocked main-mutating paths (beyond the already-fixed B-7365 reconcile path)
Wrap remaining unlocked main-mutating paths in withReentrantMainWriteLock (lock-only, no semantic change)
Add a mechanical regression guard that turns red when a main-mutating commit path ships without the lock
Regression guard must run inside lattice validate
Guard must include a negative fixture — an unlocked main-mutating primitive must make the guard fail red
Guard must not false-positive on story-worktree-only paths (merging main INTO a story branch does not mutate main)
Full per-session physical checkout isolation (maximalist architecture deferred Option B)
features.excluded_by: scope-boundary.json explicitly excludes: full per-session physical checkout isolation (a separate repo checkout per session) — the larger maximalist architecture change, intentionally deferred to a future design decision

features.feature: Main write lock scope must cover the whole critical section, not just the final write (session-ownership-and-write-leases.md Main Write Lock Rule #3)
DONE must hold the main write lock from pre-merge final check through merge and worktree cleanup (session-ownership-and-write-leases.md Main Write Lock Rule #4)
B-META finding writes must hold the main write lock (session-ownership-and-write-leases.md Main Write Lock Rule #5)
done_recover must also hold the main write lock (session-ownership-and-write-leases.md Storage section + story-lifecycle.md)
Lock acquisition failure must be blocking — Lattice must not proceed optimistically (session-ownership-and-write-leases.md Main Write Lock Rule #6)
